import re


_COMMAND_RESULT = re.compile(r"cmd=(\S+) exit=(-?\d+)")


def failed_commands(text):
    """Return command names whose result lines report a nonzero exit code."""
    failed = []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        match = _COMMAND_RESULT.fullmatch(line)
        if match and int(match.group(2)) != 0:
            failed.append(match.group(1))
    return failed
